card.name: Spots just before a name starting Wa/Pa
card.fires_on: Ordinary linking words, punctuation or spaces in history and literature text, right before a proper name is expected (such as Washington, Winkle or Westminster). It does not depend on the marked word itself.

modes.label: Before a proper name
modes.description: A comma, article or preposition that leads into a person's or place's name.
modes.example: much to the chagrin of his wife<<,>> Dame Van Winkle.

modes.label: Initials and spaces in citations
modes.description: A period after an initial or a space between figure labels, just before the next name or label.
modes.example: the popular short story "The Monkey's Paw" by W.W<<.>> Jacobs.

card.writes: It lowers the odds of continuations starting with wa or pa, and raises odd unrelated tokens, so the effect is unclear.
card.plain: It fires on small linking words in history and literature text just before a name is expected.
